Sri.Grashious Kuriakose - learned Additional Director General of Prosecution, instructed by the
learned
Government Pleader for the State of Kerala and its functionaries, submitted that, to his
informa
tion, there are no guidelines for parameters with respect to the food item called "Shawarma".
He added that most of the accidents that have been recently reported with respect to the consumption of this food appear to be on account of complications raising from the delayed use of a food raw material called "Mayonnaise".
He added that, for this perhaps, the competent Authority of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), may have to be brought on record.
2. Before this Court can take a decision on these aspects, certainly, am of the view that the Food Safety Commissioner must explain what steps have been taken, particularly with respect to the food item in question.
Though unsubstantiated yet, fatal food poisoning incidents occurring on account of this article appear to be on the rise.
Unfortunately, the aficionados of this food are the younger generation most of the time; and as is reflected in this case, the child who unfortunately died of food poisoning was only 16 years in age.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
3. As has been earlier indited by this Court, one of the main reasons why the food articles in question become poisonous is because those are not consumed within the time frames it is intended for.
The prescription of this Court - that there should be a marking on the article specifying the time,
within which it must be consumed - is certainly very vital.
4. The number of eateries in Kerala is very large, which fact can be taken judicial notice of.
Therefore, inspections have to be done consistently and without fail, because any relaxation would give an impression to the manufacturers that action would be lax.
WP(C)19941/23 & 43260/23 5.
Since the Food Safety Commissioner in Charge submits that inspections will be continued and violators dealt with, to the highest warrant in law, I am of the view that this Court will be justified in adjourning this matter for further reports.
